Three.js 0.187.0, MIT license (LICENSE.txt).
Bundled from the official npm package using esbuild 0.25.12:

npx --yes --package esbuild@0.25.12 esbuild node_modules/three/build/three.module.js --bundle --format=esm --minify --legal-comments=inline --outfile=three.module.min.js

Vendored so the native companion requires no CDN or runtime download.
